regions.cleaned_text: Sixty-one To-day . Deo Gr. John H. John H. Fischer - 60 - (1659) Abbott St. - Enrolled in S.M.S. Nov. 10th 1930. Seemed atheistic at time, wife has been Catholic. Two Children - 17 and 9. became Catholic Oct. 10, 1931 - died Nov. 1st happy. Wife had come back to church, little one baptized and youth ( 17) is taking instruc- tions. Deo Gr.

regions.cleaned_text: Grace McCarten (25) in bed almost 3 yrs. (12th of Jan 3 yrs.) - T. B. - staying with neighbor (a relief room step-ma) Was taken to Hosp. a week ago (Nov. 21) for operation apendicitis. Neighbor Miis Clancy who became her mother when taken down ... has been en- rolling Poor Souls perpetually every month for 18 month in her favor after enroling the patient her-self perpetually. and .... March 13th, 1947, last I heard G. McC. was supporting herself working about two years ago.
